newsitem.title: INDIA: India firm launches importers' directory.
newsitem.headline: India firm launches importers' directory.

text.p: India's Infocom Network Ltd said on Wednesday it launched the nation's first directory listing importers, and added that the directory would also be available on the Internet.

"Indian Importers' Directory is the first of its kind in India. Easy to refer, this comprehensive directory lists around 9,500 active Indian importers across the country, grouped under 315 product and service categories," it said in a statement.
Infocom said the directory, aimed at businessmen in India and abroad, was also available on the Internet where its address is http://www.trade-india.com.
